messages:
Lina S.: Atlas emailed: our H100 batch (60 units) slips. They can offered a partial re-allocation or swap with another customer. Proposed split: 18 immediate (FRA hub), 42 follow-on ~2026-04-22. They also proposed using 'loaner units' while replacements are inbound — is that viable? Need cost/contract detail. @Ben (procurement) @Carter (ops)

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Apologies for the delay. Full ETA if shipped in one go: 2026-04-22. Options: A) ship 18 from current stock to FRA this week, remainder 42 later; B) provide 10 loaner H100s from our loaner pool for 30 days while you wait (loan fee applies), then return or convert to purchase. DOA flow options: immediate air-replace or depot repair-first with swap-to-loaner if repair exceeds SLA. Commercials: 4% tranche delay credit OR 2% per-unit rebate if you accept depot-repair + loaner option. Loaner fee: $120/day/unit or conversion at 95% of list if purchased. Customs note: FRA clearance typically 24-48h but some lanes 72h.

Carter (ops): Loaners could really help canaries. But requirements: loaners must be pre-provisioned with our fleet OS image (image-v2.0) and matching bootloader. If Atlas cannot image, we need a depot reflash+smoke step in FRA before we sign acceptance. Also need a physical manifest and three-angle photos. Depot repair location ok if in FRA.

Ben (procurement): We're not enthusiastic about high loaner fees. The 2% per-unit rebate is probably better than 4% tranche credit if depot repair is safe. Confirm loaner conversion price and whether loaners come with same warranty terms. Also need sample amendment language for PO and loaner MSA.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Loaners carry limited warranty (30 days) unless converted. Conversion price 95% list as Ben noted. We can include depot reflash+smoke as part of the loaner onboarding at no extra labor cost if locked to FRA depot. Depot SLA: repair attempt within 5 business days; if repair not possible, swap to loaner or air-expedite replacement within 48h. Air-expedite cap: $2,000/unit for next-day carriage. We'll provide CSV manifest 24h pre-ship and a secure link to photos.

Lina S.: Ok — two primary asks: 1) if we accept depot-repair path, include mandatory post-depot perf spot-check (our 4-test suite) and sha256 of image; failing units above 1.2% must be replaced at vendor cost. 2) if we take loaners, we need immediate pre-flash in FRA to avoid post-arrival reflash cycles.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: We can capture sha256 of the flashed image, smoke logs, and 3 photos per unit. We'll run a depot perf quick-check if you give the test harness spec. Fail threshold: we can agree 1.2% replacement trigger. Include clause for customs delays >72h — vendor to cover expedited re-export fees.

Carter (ops): Manifest fields we need: unit_serial, sku, pre_ship_fw, post_reflash_fw, depot_id, photos_url, carrier_awb, loaner_flag. Also request inbound ETA window for dock reservation. If loaners are used, operations needs 24h notice to provision network ACLs and serial ingestion.

Ben (procurement): Please draft amendment options: Option A (no loaners): 4% delay credit, depot-repair accepted, 1.2% fail threshold; Option B (loaner): 2% per-unit rebate + loaner fee waiver first 7 days, conversion at 95% list. Need legal to review loaner MSA.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Draft amendment will be emailed today. Sample PO amendment snippet: 

```
PO: RW-2026-1402
Line: H100-80GB x60
Amend: Ship 18 now (FRA), balance 42 on 2026-04-22
Loaner: optional 10 units (30-day) fee=$120/day unless converted
Credits: delay_credit=4% | conditional_repair_rebate=2%/unit
```

RMA-bot: Created ticket #RMA-8522. Playbook provisional: conditional_repair=true; acceptance_window_hours=2; fail_threshold_pct=1.2; artifacts=sha256,3photos,smokelog; loaner_flow=true; notify=procurement,ops-deck,legal,customs-team.

Lina S.: Thanks. We'll review amendment and decide on loaner vs credit. Carter will confirm FRA dock availability and provide test harness spec for depot perf.

Carter (ops): I'll confirm dock slots for week of 2026-04-05 and send the harness repo link. Also need Atlas to confirm carrier AWB and whether any units are on older bootloader <1.2.0.

Vendor: AtlasLogistics: Will send amendment tonight and manifest 24h prior to ship. We'll flag bootloader versions in the manifest. Closing loop on our side.
